text:
maya: Morning team — kicking off networking bootstrap for bom1 (Mumbai) cluster. Targeting TGW peering + centralized NAT egress for initial rollout. Need quick validation checklist: TGW attachments, TGW route tables, NAT GW, private Route53 delegation, S3 egress checks. ETA ~4h.
arjun: On it, creating TGW attachment and attachment request. Will add tags and RFC notes. @sam can you prepare the route changes?
sam: Ack. Planning to add routes: 10.200.0.0/16 -> tgw-rtb-02 and default 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-gw-prod (central). I’ll run `terraform plan` & share diff before apply.
leo: Quick cost reminder — NAT Gateway in ap-south-1 has higher per-GB egress. Centralized egress saves $$ but may add latency. :thinking_face:
maya: We previously agreed central egress for stage 1 to reduce management overhead. We'll monitor egress bytes and latency; can flip to per-AZ NAT later if p99 suffers.
arjun: Creating private hosted zone bom1.internal and will add NS records in the parent zone. CLI snippet I’ll use: `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id ZPARENT --change-batch file://delegation.json`
maya: Validation step: run `dig +short @10.0.0.2 api.bom1.internal` — should resolve to app ALB IP (10.200.1.12) after ALB is up.
infra-bot: [infra-bot] TGW attach request created tgw-attach-789 by arjun. Status: pending-acceptance.
sam: Accepted and propagated. Pushed TF apply for TGW routes. Snippet: ````
Apply complete! Resources: 6 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed.
tgw_route.bom1_to_core: created
````
leo: Run connectivity check from bastion once routes are in: 
```
curl -v --resolve api.bom1.internal:443:10.200.1.12 https://api.bom1.internal/healthz
```
Expect HTTP 200.
maya: Also validate S3 egress — either via VPC endpoint or NAT. Test: `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-prod-logs --endpoint-url https://s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com` to ensure list succeeds from inside VPC.
arjun: DNS delegation propagated and dig checks passing: `dig +short @10.0.0.2 api.bom1.internal -> 10.200.1.12`. Health check returned 200 from bastion. :thumbsup:
sam: Added core->bom routes to tgw route table. Verified no blackholes; CloudWatch route-propagation metrics look normal.
maya: One blocker: NAT GW elastic IP assignment is delayed due to account quota. @infra-bot can you open a quota request so we don’t block final egress tests?
infra-bot: [infra-bot] Support case opened: CASE-2026-423. Quota request submitted for 5 additional EIPs in ap-south-1. ETA ~2h.
leo: Once quota is cleared we’ll run perf smoke tests for p99 tail latency (central NAT). If p99 > 250ms we flip to per-AZ NATs and update TGW routes.
maya: Good plan. I’ll publish a short handoff doc with checklist and results in #eng-infra/handoffs once all checks pass. Thanks everyone.
